persona.prefix: You are an OMP-style coding agent powered by the {{model}} model.
persona.suffix: Your working directory is {{cwd}}. Verify your work by running it. Keep answers brief and factual.

modes.label: Plan
modes.summary: Read-only investigation that ends in a decision-complete plan.
modes.description: Composes the read-only OMP agent preset with a read-only sandbox: edits, writes and shell mutations are unavailable, and risky actions still ask first. Mirrors OMP's plan mode.

modes.label: Build
modes.summary: The full OMP coding agent inside the workspace.
modes.description: Composes the full OMP agent preset with a workspace-write sandbox: bash and filesystem mutations stay inside the session workspace, and anything risky asks first. This is the default mode.

modes.label: YOLO
modes.summary: The full OMP coding agent with no confinement and no prompts.
modes.description: Composes the full OMP agent preset with danger-full-access and never-ask approval. Mirrors OMP's auto-approve mode; use only in throwaway workspaces.
